BETA Close X Serco Group plc has purchased a total of 1,726,134 ordinary shares on July 27-31, 2026, as part of its share buyback program, with average prices ranging from 240.5928 pence to 243.9633 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 974,295,549, with 28,450,465 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights in the company as of July 31, 2026, is 974,295,549.
